title: Travel Completed | APPR | Controllable | Delay 6�<9 hrs | Sister City + Fallback | Cash
description:
Combines TWO special handling mechanisms simultaneously under APPR: Sister City rebooking AND Fallback code. Customer's original flight AC 442 YUL?YYZ was delayed. Arrival delay code is MISSING from the system (data issue). Customer accepts rebooking to AC 443 YUL?YHM (Hamilton � sister city of YYZ). Actual arrival at YHM is 7 hours after original promised arrival at YYZ. DDS falls back to the departure delay code 42 (Scheduled Maintenance � Controllable) for eligibility assessment. Validates: (1) Sister City flag set when customer is rebooked to sister city airport, (2) Fallback flag set when arrival delay code is unavailable and departure delay code is used, (3) Both flags coexist without interfering, (4) Delay calculated as actual arrival at sister city (YHM) minus original promised arrival at original destination (YYZ), (5) Tier 2 ($700) applies for 7hr delay (6�<9hrs). Tests a different controllable fallback code from TC_030 (which used departure delay code 64) to confirm controllability classification is consistent across codes.

Prerequisites:
PNR: TC030 � single passenger Marc-Andr� Lavoie (Adult). Original itinerary: AC 442 YUL?YYZ, Scheduled arrival: 10:00 at YYZ. Original flight AC 442 DELAYED. Arrival delay code: NULL (MISSING � not received from system). Departure delay code: 42 (Scheduled Maintenance � Controllable, used as fallback). Customer offered rebooking options. Customer ACCEPTS rebooking to AC 443 YUL?YHM (Hamilton � sister city of YYZ). Rebooked flight AC 443 departs YUL and arrives YHM at 17:00. Delay: 17:00 (YHM actual) ? 10:00 (YYZ original promise) = 7hrs (420 min). Sister city mapping: YHM ? YYZ configured in system. Regime: APPR (domestic Canada, YUL?YYZ). Booking changes: INVOL � AC 442 delayed? rebooked to AC 443. Timing: >72hrs post-arrival elapsed. Filing: Within 366-day limitation. Exclusions: No duplicate case; NOT employee; NOT infant. Aeroplan: NOT linked ? Cash only. Residence: Canada ? Interac.
